subject: integration DELTA11 plan: independent CoreAnimation pass/JM test (red on HEAD)
body:
Read DELTA11 and current board/render source. Plan, production read-only, own files only:
1) New self-contained Objective-C harness compiling the real gpu/metal/nord2_render_pass.inc with minimal fake Tegu objects and a fake JM job executor (status=4 complete) that writes independent expected bytes into target storage.
2) Cases: 1080x2400 BGRA8 stride4320 and 1170x2532 BGRA8 stride4680 buffer/CAMetalLayer-shaped; 1170x2532 IOSurface-imported BGRA8; RGBA16F format115; two attachments formats80/80 and80/115 with pipeline-shaped slot1 writeMask0; load Load/Clear/DontCare; store Unknown=4 followed by setColorStoreAction:atIndex:; draw model writes only mask15 slot0 while slot1 mask0 stays untouched.
3) Assertions: non-inert accepted encoder, no command poison, clear/draw jobs complete, row-stride-correct bytes at last row, imported surface bytes unchanged outside target. Will FAIL on current HEAD at line58/natural-stride and Unknown-store; PASS after production fix. This is a pass/JM model, not a claim that the full frontend draw compiler is exercised.
4) Add dedicated runner and wire into main integration suite as a required CoreAnimation pass gate; run it standalone now (light) and report exact failure reasons. No heavy lease/phone/native/publish/commit.
If root wants the pipeline builder itself (not just its 2-attachment/mask0 descriptor shape) exercised end-to-end, say so now; full frontend draw coupling is a larger harness and I will not silently claim it.
